== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Enforcer techniques]] are methods of utilizing [[madra]] to enhance a user's physical capabilities, weapons, or specific actions. These techniques are categorized into several distinct types based on their application and scope. Full-body [[Enforcer techniques]] are common, flexible, and often manifest as external light or markings; they can reinforce the entire body to increase strength, speed, or stability, such as anchoring a user to the ground. Specialized versions include movement-based techniques for dashing or drifting, and mental or spiritual variations used to manage pain, purify elements, or harmonize with surrounding energy. Beyond full-body applications, users can employ weapon [[Enforcer techniques]] to strengthen tools or reinforce specific strikes. There are also [[Enforcer techniques|Enforcer attack techniques]], which concentrate power into a single motion or blow. While these individual attacks carry more potency than full-body methods, they are often more cumbersome and can leave a practitioner vulnerable to retaliation. Some advanced practitioners may layer multiple techniques together or combine them with other disciplines, such as [[Striker]] or [[Forger]] methods, to create complex combat effects.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|An [[Enforcer]] technique functions by using [[madra]] to power and protect a user's body until the energy is exhausted or the technique is released. These abilities can be evaluated through a specific [[binding]] meant to test their efficacy. Examples of such techniques include the [[Flowing Sword]], and they have been utilized by combatants like [[Jai Daishou]]. Additionally, the young [[Blackflame]] has employed an [[Enforcer]] technique to successfully dodge attacks.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|An [[Enforcer technique]] protects and powers a user's body with [[madra]] until the [[madra]] is depleted or the technique is dropped.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c12">''Blackflame'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[binding]] is meant to test an [[Enforcer technique]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c13">''Blackflame'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Flowing Sword]] is an [[Enforcer technique]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19">''Blackflame'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Jai Daishou]] uses an [[Enforcer technique]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c20">''Blackflame'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The young [[Blackflame]] used his [[Enforcer technique]] to dodge.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c22">''Blackflame'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The [[Enforcer]] technique is a fundamental method that can be enhanced through the use of an egg's power. This technique provides full-body strengthening and can grant increased speed, though it may also be applied as single strikes such as sword slashes or palm-strikes. Various individuals utilize this ability, including [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], [[Ekeri]], and [[Ekerinatoth]], while [[Lindon]] has used it to restrain [[Orthos]] and appeared shrouded in its burning black-and-red energy. Additionally, the power of an [[Enforcer]] technique can cause a blade to pulse with energy.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Enforcer techniques]] serve as a standard combat option for practitioners. During his battles, [[Lindon]] utilizes a [[pure madra]] technique that takes the form of blue-white flames. Other combatants employ these methods for various purposes, such as [[Akura Pride|Pride]] using a gray haze for defense or [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] utilizing one to power her jumps. Despite their utility, these techniques are subject to specific limits.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Lindon]] activates a [[pure madra]] [[Enforcer technique]] that manifests as blue-white flame.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Akura Pride|Pride]] uses a defensive [[Enforcer technique]] with a gray haze.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14">''Uncrowned'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] uses an [[Enforcer technique]] to fuel her jump.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Enforcer technique]] has limits.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
